rows.text: Charged $14.99 to Morgan's card, paid to Nomiq Domains.
rows.quote: I renewed it for a year ($14.99 to Nomiq on your Visa ending 4417).

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you, this is really appreciated, and a data analyst is exactly what we need. The project I'm leaning toward is a small, carefully sourced dataset of publicly reported safety incidents involving frontier AI models (how each was detected, how long until it was disclosed, what was fixed). The goal is evidence that's useful to the people designing incident-reporting rules. Before building anything, I want to check we wouldn't be duplicating existing work. A concrete first task, if you're up for it (2–3 weeks at your pace): survey the existing AI incident trackers (the AI Incident Database and anything similar you find), and note what fields they capture, how they're maintained, and what's missing, especially detection method and time-to-disclosure. A one-page summary would be perfect. Does that sound interesting? Happy to talk it through on a call. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: I replied as you, accepting her offer of help, and gave her a first task: a 2–3 week survey of existing AI incident trackers and what they're missing.
